name: imprint
description: This repository is its own marketplace and carries exactly one plugin: imprint, a set of working rules for multi-agent collaboration and for knowledge that has to stay provable.

plugins.name: imprint
plugins.description: Working rules in two layers: multi-agent collaboration (delegation contract, measuring before asserting, session handover) and knowledge keeping for a store that stays provable. Runs in Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity, with four skills, a read-only review agent, core card injection, subagent runtime logging, and host update watching.
